goal.objective: Prove the BirdAI Qwen executor can complete a read-only bounded slice without modifying the repository.
goal.pass_definition: Qwen returns the required terminal contract, repository scope remains unchanged, and clean-worktree validation exits 0.

validation.command: import subprocess; r=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain'], text=True, capture_output=True, check=True); assert not r.stdout.strip(), r.stdout; print('CLEAN_WORKTREE: PASS')
